column1: # Outer rounds: stack rewrite, O2 register carry, fallback copy and termination.
# Begin a stack pass; O2 computes block liveness first.
# Check middle lines against the destination register before rewriting.
# O1 falls back; O2 tries a dead carrier among r3..r5.
# Copy an unchanged line; O2 first tries the local frame rewrite.
# Finish after an unchanged pass or four stack rounds.
# O1 accepts; O2 starts up to four additional peephole rounds.
